summary: Iteration 67 verification: (a) lean find_one projections + max_time_ms on force-credit-preview / force-credit / reprocess-legacy, (b) iteration-66 reprocess/edit-brand regressions, (c) admin_diy._current_consumer delegation to routes.consumer.get_current_consumer, (d) Home.jsx SafeImage placeholder behaviour and tier-card copy. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration67_billread_cleanup.py — 16/16 pytest tests PASS. Playwright: 3 runs on /app/home with the consumer test account (9876543210) including API-response injection of EMPTY / whitespace / null / dead image URLs and a valid data-URI. All backend + frontend checks passed; no functional issues found.

design_issues.screen: Consumer Home — SafeImage placeholder (banner / hot-deal / event tiles)
issues: Fallback label uses color rgba(255,255,255,0.55) over a very light gradient (rgba(198,137,57,0.12) -> rgba(255,223,115,0.06)). On the light card background the uppercase label is barely legible (see screenshot i67_all_bad). Cosmetic only — consider a darker/neutral label colour or a higher-contrast placeholder fill.

Current preview seed data has dead/blank banner+deal+event image URLs, so the real Home screen shows placeholders for every media tile. Not a code bug, but the seeded content should get valid image URLs for realistic UX review.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py force_credit_bill: projection {_id:0, image_url:0, ocr_raw_data:0} + max_time_ms=15000 confirmed via find_one spy; doc handed to _reprocess_single_bill verified to contain neither heavy field, so the pipeline can never re-upload an image on the force-credit path (intended).

server.py force_credit_preview: projection {_id:0, amount:1, store_name:1} confirmed; response payload keys unchanged (bill_id, amount, store_name, calculated_points, rate_pct, rate_basis, category, range_label, brand_found).
server.py _reprocess_bill_full_legacy_impl: full doc {_id:0} + max_time_ms=25000 confirmed (image_url is genuinely needed there).

routes/admin_diy._current_consumer now imports routes.consumer.get_current_consumer inside the function on every request. Functionally correct (module is cached) but a module-level import would be marginally cleaner — non-blocking.

Home.jsx SafeImage: trims src, treats '', ' ' and null as missing, and flips to placeholder onError. Verified no is ever emitted and React logs no 'empty string src' warning. Valid src (data-URI) still renders a real with naturalWidth>0.
